features.feature: Signed review_run_start command persists review-runs.json entries keyed by reviewRunId, storyId, reviewer lane, reviewRound, prompt hash, head hash, material hash, and startedAt.
review_run_start rejects non-reviewer lanes, missing story/worktree context, and missing active currentReviewRound.
review_pass_set and finding_add accept reviewRunId, sign it into reviewer evidence, and verify the referenced review run.
REVIEW status and REVIEW to TEST gate require valid current-round run-bound evidence while remaining compatible for legacy stories without currentReviewRound.
Stale hash, wrong lane, wrong round, missing reviewRunId, and pre-REVIEW evidence reuse produce actionable gate failures.
Flow-fact policy semantics for review-pass, finding normalization, and REVIEW evidence freshness stay synchronized in core/flow-fact-policy.ts and truth-source docs.
Process-fact contract surfaces register review_run_start and review-runs.json across process-fact-registry, process-fact-levels, command-policy, config phase tools, and verify-process-fact-contract.
story-dispatch guidance tells REVIEW reviewers to run review_run_start first and pass reviewRunId into review_pass_set and finding_add.

Reviewer prompt mirrors are updated for every REVIEW lane that can emit pass/finding evidence: concept, quality, test-coverage, docs, behavior, and channel across packages/main/templates/agents, .claude/agents, and .Codex/agents.
AGENTS.md, story-lifecycle.md, and testing-infra.md document the new REVIEW evidence contract instead of leaving it prompt-only.

Non-REVIEW reviewer prompts and gates (koala-review-story-init, koala-review-scope-plan, product-reviewer, koala-review-delivery) are excluded from review_run_start changes because they emit init, scope, or delivery evidence rather than REVIEW pass or finding evidence.
features.excluded_by: CHK-003 limits prompt guidance to REVIEW lanes that can emit pass/finding evidence.
